title: Packed UInt64 Structural Primitives
objective: Add checked bulk uint64 residue pack/unpack and dense-matrix default formatting runtime primitives with deterministic tests and linear performance gates

oracles: existing dense GF(p) matrix serialization and default formatting semantics

handoff.summary: Added checked endian-independent uint64 pack/unpack primitives and a narrow row-major aligned uint64 matrix formatter. Randomized differential tests cover widths 1, 2, 4, and 8 plus overflow, exact byte length, rectangular, and empty-matrix semantics. On the validation host, 500x500 pack+unpack took 48-50 ms and formatting took 24-29 ms.
risks: The integration-owned native-boundary inventory must be regenerated after cherry-pick because the three new runtime intrinsics are intentionally outside this compiler-runtime lane's claims.

The full integration tier is not green at the base commit: exact-polynomial resource counts expect 71 adapters while the integrated declaration emits 97, and graph native dependencies are not provisioned in this worktree.
next_steps: Run `node bin/sagejs ffi audit --write` in the integration lane and classify the three new runtime boundaries.
Use the primitives from Matrix packed residue import/export and default unsubdivided GF(p) formatting in a separate arithmetic-algebra lane.
